citations.quote: Assessment: new hyperkalemia with acute kidney injury; etiology not yet clear (differential includes reduced renal potassium clearance, ACE inhibitor effect and recent spironolactone use).

claim_verdicts.why: The 3/2 physician note lists recent spironolactone use in the differential for the initial hyperkalemia, and the home-medication line confirms daily use before the first high potassium. The claim is hedged as a plausible contributor, which the record leaves open.
claim_verdicts.uncertainty: No note attributes the first episode specifically to spironolactone, and the etiology is documented as not yet clear. Other candidates (AKI, lisinopril) are also listed. Cause (2026-02-19) precedes effect (2026-03-02T09:30) (date inherited from note header): temporally possible, but timing alone does not prove causation.
